title: Validated names for experimental studies
text: Pass "Asian", "Black", "Hispanic", "White" race select_names(). intended signals used study. pinned package returns six columns: name, identity, pct_correct, avg_income, avg_education, avg_citizenship. first two identify name intended signal. pct_correct share perceived signal. Income education average ratings 1–5 scales; citizenship share 0–1 scale. default, least 80% respondents must perceived intended racial signal. Set pct_correct change threshold. function samples five names default. Set n_names request , set random seed need reproduce selection. can order eligible names validation measure order_by_var. Use pct_correct share perceived intended racial signal, avg_income avg_education average ratings, avg_citizenship share perceived citizens. selects highest values keeps ties, ordered result can contain n_names rows. select_names_all() combines four racial groups using default selection . pinned version, accepts selection arguments doesn’t pass select_names(). Call select_names() separately group want change threshold, ordering, sample size.
code: asian_names <- select_names(race = "Asian") # Asian signalling names   asian_names # Lower the required share from 80% to 70%.  lower_threshold_names <- select_names(race = "Asian", pct_correct = 0.7) # Sample ten eligible names. set.seed(42)   greater_n_names <- select_names(race = "Asian", n_names = 10) top_correct_names <- select_names(race = "Asian", order_by_var = "pct_correct") all_race_names <- select_names_all()
